training.selection_metric: per fit: validation original-scale MAE on the 2023 ALL cohort (unchanged v28 fit_config)
training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch
training.same_recipe_as: v29 TSMixer_last10_all (scripts/train_kelmarsh_multiyear_benchmark.fit_config, unchanged); only the balanced arm overrides the two loss weights

statistics.cohort: computed separately on test all and test normal
statistics.seed_handling: losses averaged over the 3 seeds on identical windows
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm over the C1-C3 MAE Newey-West p-values within each cohort; raw p retained
statistics.rmse: issue-time block bootstrap of squared-error sums; separate from the MAE CI

p3.authorization: User approved P2 merge and 2022 on 2026-11-04, then explicitly approved 2023 and 2024 in the same chat. Claude HANDOFF #22 delegates this implementation.
p3.recipe: P2 unchanged unbalanced 0.8 MAE + 0.2 MSE; TSMixerBasicSmall 2 blocks, ff32, dropout0.1; fit_config unchanged; epoch0 eligible; no refit
p3.data_identity: D2-0 test_year_registration.json, part_A.json and input_hashes.json locked by utils.penmanshiel_v35.D2_SHA; verify raw size/SHA/official MD5 where registered before parsing; P1 development rows and raw upstream values must match exactly
p3.preparation: Reuse frozen P1 numerical functions, fixed 2016-2019 normal-cohort power curves, canonical duplicate normalization, strict original six-tick hourly labels. Never fill, clip or interpolate labels. Stop on any preparation discrepancy.
p3.preprocessing: Per-fold full P/K fits use only fit_years for scaler and upstream fill. Zero-shot and FT use source K statistics only. Scratch uses only its few-shot fit segment; target reductions forbidden for transfer.

fewshot.windows: inputs and targets within month interval; fit targets end before cut; validation targets begin at cut

statistics.holm: R,F1,F3 MAE two-sided p-values within each confirmation fold only; no cross-year family-wise claim
statistics.success: MAE CI95 lower>0 AND Holm p<=0.05 AND RMSE gain CI95 lower>0

reporting.two_years: 两个独立年份确认（滚动时间隔离，不宣称统计独立）
reporting.epoch0: FT-1 selected epoch0 means direct Kelmarsh model versus Scratch recipe; not evidence of fine-tuning benefit

execution_order: commit and push protocol before unsealing
prepare and verify every old 2016-2021 row
persist test_evaluation_started before any held-out prediction or metric

resume.reuse: verify completed fits by contract and artifact hashes; interrupted epochs use unchanged frozen trainer last.pt RNG/optimizer state
resume.after_test_evaluation_started: no restart even if evaluation fails
resume.validation_note: fold-specific 2022/2023 validation MAE is allowed solely for that fold checkpoint selection; it is not final held-out evaluation and cannot change other folds or recipes

prohibited: rerun after final test evaluation starts
